_doc: e5-base-v2 label prototypes. A label's vector is the L2-normalised mean of its examples' vectors; texts and examples both take text_prefix/example_prefix ('query: ', which the e5 card prescribes for classification features; measured best on the context.md injection sample). Probabilities are softmax(cosine / temperature). `heads` are matched by their exact label set inside decide(); `risk` serves the risk tool; triage and rank use the caller's labels or criterion the same way.

read: only fetches, lists, searches or views data and changes nothing
GITHUB GET A REPOSITORY owner acme repo api
NOTION QUERY DATABASE filter status done
OUTLOOK LIST MESSAGES folder inbox top 20
write: creates, edits or updates data in an account or file, reversible
NOTION CREATE PAGE title meeting notes
GITHUB UPDATE A PULL REQUEST title fix
LINEAR CREATE ISSUE team eng title bug
send: sends a message, email, post or invite that reaches other people
SLACK SEND MESSAGE channel general text hello
OUTLOOK SEND EMAIL to team subject update
GMAIL REPLY TO THREAD thread 9 body thanks
destructive: deletes, removes, revokes, cancels or overwrites data that cannot be restored
GITHUB DELETE A REPOSITORY owner acme repo old
